description: Create editable Strudel, LilyPond, and SuperCollider music source with local handoff actions.

defaultPrompt: Make a sparse 112 BPM dub-techno loop in Strudel: restrained 909 drums, a minor bass pulse, and hazy electric-piano chords.
Write a D-minor piano sarabande in LilyPond: two eight-bar phrases with a simple left-hand bass.
Make a 96 BPM generative ambient piece in SuperCollider with glassy FM tones and slow minor harmonies.
interface.longDescription: Turn natural-language music requests into editable Strudel, LilyPond, or SuperCollider source, with links and local handoff actions for playback and editing.

name: music-as-code
